claims.claim: Amazon agreed to a $2.5 billion settlement resolving FTC allegations concerning Prime enrollment and cancellation practices.
According to the FTC complaint, some Uber One users could be required to navigate as many as 23 screens and take as many as 32 actions to cancel.
FTC staff describes dark patterns as design practices that can obscure, subvert, or impair consumer choice and includes difficult subscription cancellation among the tactics discussed.
In 2026 the FTC opened a new advance notice of proposed rulemaking on negative option marketing after the 2024 amended rule had been vacated by the Eighth Circuit in July 2025.
